title: unscaled dot-product attention underperforms additive attention for large key dimensions due to softmax saturation
description: For large values of d_k, additive attention outperforms dot-product attention without scaling because dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing softmax into regions with extremely small gradients. This is a known limitation of dot-product attention that motivates the scaling factor used in the Transformer.
canonical_description: unscaled dot-product attention underperforms additive attention for large key dimensions due to softmax saturation

evidence.anchor: additive attention outperforms dot product attention without scaling for larger values of d_k
evidence.quote: While for small values of $d_k$ the two mechanisms perform similarly, additive attention outperforms dot product attention without scaling for larger values of $d_k$ [CITE:DBLP:journals/corr/BritzGLL17].
